title: SalesOps - Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation - Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 8+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.
* Strong client relationships, team engagement, talent development, and contribution to pursuit and practice growth.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.
  
  
The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Autonomously manage global primary market research (qualitative and quantitative) of all levels of complexity, incorporating diverse stakeholder perspectives to ensure organizational alignment and buy-in. Strength in applying advanced statistical analyses and leveraging business intelligence to support strategic, tactical and operational initiatives as well as planning and implementation of new and potential USP products and programs is essential.
* Steward projects to generate actionable and meaningful insights. Develop research plans to meet business needs, consult with internal business partners, establish and manage schedules, monitor progress, and compellingly communicate the results
* Acquire and manage market research vendors to ensure quality work is provided on-time, on-budget, and that it is reported with a suitable degree of professionalism
* Proactively serve as a thought partner with USP leadership. Participate in corporate planning and new product development processes to identify opportunities, address needs, and support the development of business and marketing plans
* Proactively bring external perspectives and insight into business planning for the organization, accomplished through:
* Monitor trends in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food and other related industries to assess their implications for USP business lines
* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Basic Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Preferred majors in market research, marketing, science, business, or related social science discipline.
* 7 or more years of experience in applying Market Research to solve broad strategic business problems.
* Strong business writing skills – evidence of succinct, distilled reports and attention to detail through thoroughness and accuracy
* Strong verbal and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to present statistical information to non-statistically oriented audiences
* Widespread knowledge of advanced primary market research methodology.
* Business acumen and strong analytical skills
* Advanced Intermediate skills with the following programs:
* MS Excel
* MS PowerPoint
* MS Word
* Online survey tools, bulletin boards and focus group platforms (Qualtrics preferred)
* Statistical software packages – R, SPSS, etc.
* Has the ability to navigate through ambiguity with courage and leadership.
* Must be self-motivated and customer-focused.
* Excellent time and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to concurrently prioritize multiple tasks with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Prior experience in global market research, pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food or related, regulated industries is highly desired.
* Experience working in a not-for-profit organization.
* Experience working in a scientific organization.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Sales & Marketing
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

**Job Description**
**At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything.**
Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity.
  
  
**Sub Function**
Forward Deployed Engineering, Full Stack Product Engineering, Digital Solutions & Cloud Applications
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Reports To**
Director, Product Engineering / ICC
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a highly capable Forward Deployed Engineer, Full Stack, Lead Engineer to work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering partners to design, build, deploy, and operationalize modern digital solutions in real-world enterprise environments.
  
  
This role will serve as a hands-on technical lead embedded close to users and product teams, translating ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable, and production-ready full stack solutions. The successful candidate will bridge product strategy, solution architecture, engineering execution, deployment, adoption, and operational support across Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep full stack engineering expertise, strong systems thinking, customer-facing problem solving, cloud-native delivery experience, DevSecOps discipline, and the ability to rapidly prototype, harden, and scale solutions within regulated enterprise technology environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Forward Deployed Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Act as the technical lead for customer-embedded delivery efforts, owning solution discovery, design, build, deployment, and adoption from concept to production.
* Lead by influence across product managers, architects, engineers, data teams, AI teams, cybersecurity, quality, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex and evolving business needs into actionable technical designs, prototypes, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Mentor engineers on solution design, secure coding, debugging, technical decision-making, and production-readiness practices.

Full Stack Product Engineering
  
  

* Design and build modern web applications, APIs, services, workflow tools, dashboards, portals, automation components, and integration layers.
* Rapidly prototype solutions with users, validate value, iterate based on feedback, and convert prototypes into maintainable production-grade applications.
* Own implementation across front-end, back-end, API, database, identity, integration, observability, and deployment layers.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, accessible, performant, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.

Deployment, Integration & Enterprise Platforms
  
  

* Deploy and integrate solutions within complex enterprise environments, including legacy systems, cloud platforms, identity services, data platforms, and third-party applications.
* Apply cloud-native patterns, microservices, API-first design, event-driven integration, containerization, and managed services where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues, resolve integration blockers, optimize performance, and address edge cases in live business workflows.
* Capture deployment learnings and convert them into reusable engineering patterns, product improvements, accelerators, and reference architectures.

DevSecOps & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, quality gates, security scans, infrastructure automation, and release management practices.
* Establish operational KPIs covering reliability, performance, deployment frequency, incident trends, and service health.
* Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and quality teams to ensure secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Drive root cause analysis, technical debt reduction, application rationalization, and continuous platform improvement.

Stakeholder & Product Delivery
  
  

* Run discovery workshops, technical deep dives, and solution design sessions with business users, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Communicate trade-offs, risks, technical options, and delivery progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with product teams to convert field insights into backlog items, platform enhancements, roadmap inputs, and adoption strategies.
* Balance rapid delivery, business value, user adoption, security, compliance, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Compliance, Security & Quality
  
  

* Ensure applications comply with applicable enterprise security, privacy, quality, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
* Support delivery practices aligned with GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), GDPR, HIPAA, and internal J&J technology standards where applicable.
* Maintain audit-ready engineering documentation, traceability, and release evidence for regulated applications.
* Promote responsible use of data and AI-enabled capabilities within application experiences.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's Degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, full stack development, enterprise application delivery, solution engineering, or digital product engineering.
* 3+ years of experience as a technical lead, lead engineer, solution architect, forward deployed engineer, or senior hands-on engineering owner.
* Proven experience building and deploying production-grade full stack applications using modern front-end, back-end, API, database, and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with business users or customers to discover needs, design solutions, implement integrations, troubleshoot issues, and drive adoption.
* Experience with Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, release management, and production support practices.
* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or other regulated industries preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Front-End Engineering**
**Back-End & APIs**
**Cloud & DevSecOps**
**Engineering Practices**

* React / Angular / modern JavaScript frameworks
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* HTML5 / CSS3
* Responsive design
* Accessibility and UX collaboration
* Java / .NET / Node.js / Python
* REST APIs and microservices
* API security and authentication
* Relational and NoSQL databases
* Event-driven integrations

* Containers and Kubernetes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering solutions for Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, enterprise data platforms, or internal business productivity use cases.
* Experience integrating applications with analytics platforms, AI services, workflow tools, enterprise identity, API gateways, and data products.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and rapid experimentation is required to validate business value.
* Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, software architecture, Agile, DevOps, cybersecurity, or application engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to simplify complex technology topics, influence without authority, and build trust with stakeholders.

title: Manager, Ads and Shopping, Trust and Safety, Content
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields.
* 8 years of experience in business strategy, technology research, anti-abuse, policy, data analytics, cyber-security, program management or related fields.
* 2 years of experience in people management, leading teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant field.
* Education in, or experience with, machine learning.
* Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization/dashboards, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).
* Experience working with engineering and product teams to create tools, solutions, or automation to improve user safety.
* Experience working closely with policy teams.
* Ability to translate complex data analyses and emerging abuse trends into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders and leadership.

**About The Job**
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
  
  
Our team has the critical mission of protecting and respecting Google's users, ensuring online safety in both core and emerging areas. We are at the center of the company-wide charge to raise the bar on content, including coherent policies and scaled and effective enforcement. We have recently expanded beyond traditional product protections focusing on additional types of abuse: brand safety, controversial content, violent extremism, and political interference. We've advanced user protections, and demonstrated expertise across Google’s growing array of products and services.
  
  
In this role, you’ll lead a team, be a thought leader, an excellent operator and will collaborate cross-functionally. You will bring passion for abuse fighting, focus on putting the user first and lead a high performing team to deliver excellent business results. You will partner with key stakeholders to drive operational performance and lower abuse rates.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect the roadmap for global ads defense. Oversee the deployment of analytical frameworks and fraud-detection methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate content that violates Google Ads policies, staying one step ahead of evolving adversarial tactics.
* Lead strategic cross-functional initiatives by partnering with executive stakeholders across product, engineering, legal, Public Relation (PR), and public policy to influence long-term technical roadmaps, roll out policy updates, and ensure safer-by-design product features.
* Forge and scale a team of subject matter experts. Advocate a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety, ensuring your team remains resilient and high-performing while navigating the rapid pace and sensitive nature of global ads content and policies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: CRM Solution/Data Architect (Senior Manager) – Pharma
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
Our CX Strategy & Digital Transformation team is building next-generation commercial, medical, and customer engagement capabilities powered by Salesforce, AI, Data Cloud, and advanced analytics. We are seeking a strategic and highly experienced architect who can design the future-state CRM and customer data ecosystem supporting scalable growth across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
  
  
The Senior Manager, CRM Solution & Data Architect will define and govern the enterprise CRM, customer data, integration, and engagement architecture. This role will serve as the primary architecture leader across Salesforce, Data Cloud, customer master data, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, and connected enterprise platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep Salesforce architecture expertise with strong data architecture, master data management, integration design, and pharmaceutical commercial process knowledge. The role will partner with business leaders, product owners, engineering teams, data teams, security, and external partners to deliver scalable, compliant, and business-aligned solutions.
  
  
**WORK SCHEDULE: This position requires full coverage of US Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) and is not a standard India daytime work schedule**
**Principal Responsibilities**
**CRM & Enterprise Solution Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end CRM architecture strategy supporting Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
* Establish future-state architecture roadmaps across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, Marketing Cloud, and emerging AI capabilities.
* Translate business strategy and product roadmaps into scalable solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation guardrails.
* Develop and govern architecture standards, reusable design patterns, platform principles, and technology blueprints across the CRM ecosystem.
* Evaluate new technologies and vendor capabilities against enterprise architecture, security, data, and business priorities.

**Data Architecture & Customer 360 Strategy**

* Lead customer data architecture across HCP, HCO, KOL, patient, account, territory, consent, affiliation, and engagement data domains.
* Define Customer 360 architecture leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud, enterprise customer master platforms, and third-party data sources.
* Design scalable canonical and platform data models supporting engagement, commercial effectiveness, reporting, analytics, and AI.
* Establish data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, survivorship, matching, and identity-resolution standards.
* Drive master data management alignment across CRM, ERP, enterprise data platforms, IQVIA, and commercial applications.

**Integration & Platform Architecture**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce and Snowflake, IQVIA, customer master, ERP, data warehouse, marketing automation, patient services, sales enablement, and analytics platforms.
* Define API-led, middleware, batch, event-driven, and real-time integration patterns based on business and technical requirements.
* Ensure integration architecture meets scalability, resiliency, performance, monitoring, supportability, and security expectations.
* Guide delivery teams on platform interoperability, interface contracts, error handling, observability, and enterprise integration standards.

**AI, Analytics & Data Cloud Enablement**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to define AI-enabled CRM, field productivity, customer engagement, and decision-support use cases.
* Lead architecture for Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein capabilities, predictive analytics, and customer intelligence initiatives.
* Ensure customer and engagement data is structured and governed to support segmentation, personalization, next best action, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish trusted, reusable datasets and reporting architecture.

**Governance, Compliance & Security**

* Define architecture governance covering design reviews, standards compliance, technology decisions, nonfunctional requirements, and release readiness.
* Ensure CRM and data solutions align with applicable pharmaceutical, privacy, security, and records-management requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA expectations.
* Establish security architecture standards for role-based access, classification, privacy, encryption, auditability, retention, and risk management.
* Lead architecture assessments for internal and vendor-delivered solutions, documenting decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation actions.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted architecture advisor to Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital, Data & Analytics, Security, and IT leadership.
* Lead discovery sessions, architecture workshops, solution reviews, roadmap planning, and executive-level design discussions.
* Mentor solution architects, developers, data engineers, administrators, and technical leads while raising architecture maturity.
* Provide thought leadership on CRM modernization, customer data strategy, AI adoption, and pharmaceutical engagement technologies.
* Oversee consulting partners and ensure internal team members participate throughout the design journey to build sustainable knowledge and ownership.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in CRM, enterprise architecture, data architecture, or solution architecture, including leadership at a senior manager or equivalent level.
* 10+ years of Salesforce platform architecture experience with ownership of complex, enterprise-scale solutions.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Veeva, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, and related capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of customer master data management, Customer 360, identity resolution, data governance, metadata management, and data quality.
* Experience architecting enterprise integrations using APIs, middleware, event-driven architecture, batch processing, and cloud-native patterns.
* Proven experience leading large-scale CRM transformation, platform modernization, data migration, and operating-model initiatives.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical processes including HCP/HCO engagement, Medical Affairs, patient services, KOL management, territory management, consent, compliance, and omnichannel engagement.
* Experience with healthcare and commercial data ecosystems, including IQVIA and customer reference data.
* Knowledge of Snowflake, Azure data services, enterprise data warehouses, analytics platforms, and modern data architecture patterns.
* Experience with Salesforce AI, Agentforce, Einstein, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities required
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, decision-making, and vendor leadership skills.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams and external consulting partners.

**Required Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Data Architect
* Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
* Salesforce Certified Sharing and Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Architect
* Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified AI Specialist
* Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
* TOGAF certification preferred
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) preferred

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Enterprise AI Architect - AI Product Design & Solutioning
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India, Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
8–12 years total, with at least 4 years in architecture roles and 2+ years building AI/ML solutions in production

**Compensation:**
₹32–48 LPA fixed

**About Assentcode Technologies**

Assentcode Technologies is a Hyderabad-based software services company, founded in 2019 by a group of entrepreneurial engineers. We help businesses across the globe build, modernize, and scale their technology, with offices in Hyderabad and Frisco, Texas (USA).

Our core services include:

* Product Engineering (product design and development, web and mobile apps, UI/UX)
* Data Analytics, AI/ML, chatbots, and virtual assistants
* Cloud solutions, DevOps, and CI/CD
* Legacy modernization and digital transformation
* Custom enterprise software and quality engineering

We are a lean, fast-moving team, and AI is one of our biggest growth areas. We are looking for an enterprise architect who can turn a client's business problem into a well-designed, production-grade AI solution.

**About the Role**

As our Enterprise AI Architect, you will own the technical design of AI products and solutions for our enterprise clients, from the first discovery conversation to production architecture. You will decide what to build, which models and patterns to use, how it integrates with the client's systems, and how it stays secure, reliable, and cost-effective at scale. This is a hands-on architecture role: you will define the blueprint, guide the delivery team, and stay close enough to the code to validate that what's built matches what was designed.

You will also work closely with our business development team as the technical voice in client conversations, so you should be comfortable explaining complex AI concepts to both engineers and executives.

**What You Will Own**

Client Problem → Discovery → Solution Architecture → Proof of Concept → Estimation and Proposal → Delivery Guidance → Production Readiness → Continuous Improvement

**Key Responsibilities**

*Solution Design and Architecture*

* Translate business problems into AI solution architectures, including GenAI/LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, predictive models, and intelligent automation
* Select the right approach for each problem: build vs. buy, open-source vs. proprietary models, fine-tuning vs. RAG vs. prompt engineering, and when AI is not the right answer
* Design end-to-end architectures covering data ingestion, vector stores, model serving, orchestration, APIs, integration with enterprise systems, and user-facing applications
* Create architecture documents, solution blueprints, and technical diagrams that delivery teams can build from

*Client and Pre-Sales Engagement*

* Join discovery workshops with CTOs, CIOs, and business leaders to understand objectives, constraints, and data readiness
* Support the business development team with technical proposals, SOW inputs, effort estimates, and architecture presentations
* Build and demo proofs of concept to validate feasibility and win client confidence
* Present trade-offs, risks, and timelines honestly, and manage client expectations on what AI can and cannot deliver

*Delivery Leadership*

* Provide technical direction to engineering, data, and DevOps teams during implementation
* Review designs and code for architectural integrity, scalability, and maintainability
* Define standards for LLMOps/MLOps: CI/CD for models, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and rollback
* Mentor engineers and help build our internal AI capability

*Quality, Security, and Governance*

* Establish evaluation frameworks for AI quality: accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, cost per query, and bias
* Design for data privacy, security, access control, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA where relevant)
* Apply responsible AI practices, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop design, and auditability
* Optimize for performance and cloud cost without compromising reliability

*Innovation and Thought Leadership*

* Track the fast-moving AI landscape (models, frameworks, tools, and best practices) and decide what is ready for enterprise use
* Build reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and templates that speed up future projects
* Contribute to case studies, technical content, and our AI service positioning

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 8–12 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or ML, with at least 3 years in an architect or technical lead role
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI/ML solutions that reached production, with examples you can walk us through
* Strong practical experience with Generative AI: LLM integration, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and when to use classical ML vs. LLM-based approaches
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
* Strong software architecture skills: microservices, APIs, event-driven design, data pipelines, and system integration
* Strong Python skills and the ability to review code and build prototypes
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps: model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and CI/CD
* Understanding of data architecture, including data lakes, warehouses, ETL/ELT, and data quality
* Knowledge of security, privacy, and governance requirements for enterprise AI
* Excellent communication skills: able to explain architecture to executives and engineers alike
* Experience working with international clients and distributed teams

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a services, consulting, or multi-client environment
* Pre-sales or solutioning experience, including proposals, estimates, and client presentations
* Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models (Llama, Mistral, etc.) and deploying them on your own infrastructure
* Familiarity with tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
* Exposure to legacy modernization or integrating AI into existing enterprise applications
* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or AI/ML specializations
* Contributions to open-source projects, published content, or conference talks
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You…**

* Have worked only on research, notebooks, or proofs of concept that never reached production
* Have only used AI through no-code tools or API wrappers, without architectural depth
* Prefer a purely advisory role with no involvement in implementation
* Are not comfortable engaging directly with clients and business stakeholders
* Want a large, highly structured organization with a fully defined process

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Quality and clarity of architectures and solution designs delivered

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Global HealthX**




  





 Global HealthX is on a mission to reshape how people experience healthcare. We build products that
 



 touch real patients and providers, in a market that is early, enormous, and moving fast. We are past the"will this work" stage and squarely in the "how big can this get" stage which means whoever joins
 



 now gets to shape the product, the roadmap, and the culture while the story is still being written.
 



  





**About Healix Engage**




  





 Healix Engage is our patient and provider engagement platform — the layer that turns healthcare
 



 interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a
 



 roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only
 



 dream about: core problems still to be solved, and the freedom to solve them well.
 



  





**The Role**




  





 We are looking for a Product Manager to own Healix Engage end to end. This is not a backloggrooming, ticket\-shuffling role. You will set direction, make the hard calls on what gets built and what does not, and be accountable for outcomes not just output. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and leadership, with unusual latitude to run experiments, kill bad ideas quickly, and double down on what is working.
 



 If you have been the PM who quietly does the strategic thinking while someone senior takes the
 



 meeting this is your chance to take the meeting.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  




* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Healix Engage, and translate it into a sequence of releases that compound.
* Talk to users constantly patients, providers, internal teams and turn what you hear into sharp product decisions.
* Define the problems worth solving, write crisp specs, and partner with engineering and design to ship fast without shipping sloppy.
* Use data to decide. Set the metrics that matter, instrument them, and let the numbers not opinions settle debates.
* Prioritize ruthlessly against limited time and resources the hallmark of a great PM at a growing company.
* Be the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone aligned on the "why" and the "what's next."



  





**What We're Looking For**




  




* Roughly 3–5 years in product management, ideally including time taking a product from early to scaling (0→1 or 1→10 experience is a big plus).
* A track record of shipping products that moved real metrics you can point to specific outcomes you are proud of.
* Strong product intuition paired with genuine comfort in data; you can zoom from strategy to a Figma detail to a SQL query and back.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and course\-correct quickly.
* Clear, persuasive communication you can align a room and write a spec that does not need a translator.
* A builder's temperament: high ownership, low ego, and a bias for action. You would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.



  





 Bonus: experience in healthcare, health\-tech, or another regulated, high\-trust domain.

title: (Agentic) Product Manager
description:
**About This Role**
 We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
   

  

 You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 Strategic ownership
   

  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities


 Execution leadership
   

  

* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively


 Partnership with platform PMs
   

  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success


**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
 AI\-native products or features that users love
   

  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.


 Core capabilities
   

  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

title: IT & Data PO D&A MDM Platform
description:
**Product Owner Master Data Workflow** 




  





**About the Role:** 




  





 Master data workflows are how product, customer, and vendor data is requested, enriched, validated, approved, and distributed across Danones global landscape spanning Orsoft (master data system of entry), SAP ECC / S/4HANA, and the surrounding integration layer across Customer, Vendor, Materials and Finance MD domains.
 



 As Product Owner for the Master Data Workflow, you deeply understand the needs of the requestors, data stewards, approvers, and downstream consumers who depend on these workflows, and you own the vision, roadmap, and backlog of the platform. You will Own workflow capabilities supporting Product, Customer, Vendor, and future master data domains across the enterprise . You are mandated by the organization and its stakeholders to turn that vision into a product that delivers maximum value to Danone and its business functions and you are accountable end\-to\-end for user satisfaction with the workflow product.
 



**You own the what and the why.** 
 You define outcomes, prioritize the backlog, and decide what gets built and in what order.
 



  





  





**Location \| Experience \| How to Apply:** 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Experience:** 
 9\-12 Years
 



**How to Apply:** 
 Interested candidates can also apply directly via the
 **Infosys Careers Page (https://career.infosys.com/jobdesc?jobReferenceCode\=INFSYS\-EXTERNAL\-254034\&rc\=0\)** 




 Global stakeholder exposure
 



 Opportunity to be part of a large\-scale transformation journey
 



 Good to have experience in consumer goods, manufacturing, retail, or related industry domains
 



  





**Technical Skills Required** 




  




* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 7\+ years in enterprise IT\&Data, including proven experience as a Product Owner / Product Manager (or equivalent) owning the vision, roadmap, and backlog of a technical or platform product.
* Strong command of agile product ownership: backlog management and prioritization, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, release planning, and working in Scrum / Kanban / hybrid (SAFe an advantage).
* Sufficient domain fluency in SAP master data (material / product, customer, vendor) and in master\-data workflow / BPM (e.g. Orsoft, SAP Business Workflow, SAP MDG) to prioritize credibly, shape requirements, and partner effectively with the technical Chapter — without needing to be the hands\-on design authority.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and data\-governance needs into product outcomes and measurable value.
* Excellent stakeholder management across business and IT up to senior\-management level; able to align priorities and to say “no” constructively.
* Outcome\- and data\-driven decision\-making; comfortable prioritizing under constraints and ambiguity.
* Fluent English (written and spoken); effective in a global, multicultural, matrixed organization.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Product ownership of master\-data, workflow, or platform products in a large, matrixed enterprise.
* Familiarity with Orsoft\-based master data processes and with S/4HANA migration programs and their workflow implications — enough to prioritize and plan, not to configure.
* Understanding of data\-governance operating models (data owners, stewards, councils) and how workflows operationalize them.
* Awareness of process mining, workflow analytics, and automation (RPA, low\-code) as levers on the product roadmap.
* FMCG / CPG industry experience and its master\-data characteristics (innovation cycles, regulatory attributes, customer hierarchies).
* Working knowledge of agile / hybrid delivery (Scrum, SAFe) and ITSM (ITIL) as it relates to product operations.
* Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration across SAP and non\-SAP ecosystems



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Vision \& Strategy** 



* Define, communicate, and continuously evolve the vision and strategy for the Master Data Workflow, aligned to the MDM and IT\&Data strategy and to the needs of the business functions it serves.
* Translate business and data\-governance objectives into a clear product direction and measurable outcomes (e.g. cycle\-time, right\-first\-time quality, self\-service adoption).



**Backlog Management** 



* Own, maintain, and prioritize a single, transparent product backlog for the Workflow, spanning enhancement, project, and transformation demand.
* Make the prioritization calls — what is in, what is out, what waits — balancing value, risk, effort, and dependencies; define guardrails and functional scope for product extensions where the operating model requires them.



**Requirement Gathering \& Refinement** 



* Work closely with business process owners, data owners, and data stewards to gather, clarify, and refine requirements into well\-formed backlog items and user stories.
* Ensure data\-quality and governance needs are expressed as product requirements, in partnership with Data Governance and DQ teams.



**Release Planning \& Roadmapping** 



* Own the product roadmap and plan and prioritize releases with the squad and stakeholders.
* Manage the global roadmap and its communication — keeping stakeholders aligned on what is coming, when, and why.



**Plan \& Review** 



* Plan the work with the squad, then review and accept completed increments, demonstrating delivered value to stakeholders.
* Keep the backlog and product artefacts current for the applicable delivery framework (Scrum, Kanban, hybrid / waterfall).



**Dependency Management** 



* Identify and manage dependencies — across Orsoft, SAP ECC / S/4HANA, the integration layer (e.g. Tibco), and other products — that affect the platform’s success, coordinating and escalating through product and program governance as needed.



**Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Act as the primary liaison between the squad and stakeholders across Finance, Marketing, R\&I, and Supply Chain, ensuring needs, trade\-offs, and decisions are understood on both sides.
* Represent the product in product\-group, architecture, and program governance forums, and communicate value delivered to both technical and executive audiences.



**Acceptance Criteria Definition** 



* Define clear acceptance criteria so the team knows when a requirement is complete and ready for release, safeguarding quality and fitness\-for\-purpose from the user’s perspective.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Actively seek feedback from stakeholders, squad members, and end\-users to identify improvement opportunities, and foster adherence to product and agile best practices.
* Use adoption, quality, and performance signals to drive simplification and continuous improvement of the workflow product.



**Workflow** 
**Governance** 



* Ensure workflow designs and approval processes align with Danone's Data Governance framework, stewardship model, segregation of duties, audit requirements, and compliance obligations.
* Partner with Data Governance teams to continuously improve stewardship experience and governance effectiveness.



**Adoption \& Change Management** 



* Drive adoption of workflow capabilities through stakeholder engagement, training needs identification, communications, and feedback management.
* Champion user experience improvements that increase compliance, efficiency, and self\-service.



**Automation \& Innovation** 



* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate workflow activities through AI, workflow intelligence, low\-code platforms, RPA, and business rules automation.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on workflow efficiency and user experience.



**Key Deliverables** 



* Product vision and strategy for the Master Data Workflow.
* Product roadmap and product OKRs.
* A relevant, up\-to\-date, and prioritized product backlog.
* User stories, acceptance criteria, and the deliverables required by the applicable framework (Scrum, Kanban, hybrid / waterfall).
* Release plans and roadmap communications to stakeholders.
* Defined and realized product value (adoption, cycle\-time, and quality outcomes).
* Extension guardrails and functional scope, where the product operating model requires them.



**Key Interactions** 




**Internal** 



* Product Analysts and squad members within scope.
* Chapter Lead and Chapter Manager (technical counterpart).
* Global business and function stakeholders — data owners and stewards across Finance, Marketing, R\&I, and Supply Chain.
* Product Group Lead and Product Lead; IT\&Data leadership.
* Peer Product Owners / Extension Product Owners; Business Partners.
* Program Leads / Deployment Project Managers.



**External** 



* Technology providers (Orsoft, SAP, integration vendors).

title: AI Ops Application Operations Lead
description:
**Role Overview**
 The AI Ops Application Operations Lead owns the production lifecycle of agentic coding applications, plugins, and skills across Zeta. The role helps teams move high\-value prototypes into production and keeps applications reliable, useful, governed, and measurable after launch.
   

  

 This role partners closely with application owners, AI Operations, IT, Security, and other technical teams. Its primary focus is production readiness, lifecycle and release management, feedback loops, and clear visibility into adoption, performance, and business impact.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines application operations, technical program management, and product fluency. They do not need to be the primary developer for every application, but they must be comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools, understanding application architecture, translating business needs into technical requirements, and coordinating work across stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Readiness and Launch**
* Partner with owners of agenticly coded applications to assess whether an application is ready to move from prototype to production.
* Establish and manage a consistent production\-readiness process covering security, privacy, data access, architecture, user experience, support, monitoring, and documentation.
* Identify launch risks, dependencies, and gaps, and coordinate the work required to address them.
* Connect application owners with IT, Security, Data, Legal, and other teams involved in production approval and deployment.
* Develop launch plans, readiness checklists, support models, and ownership documentation for each application.
* Ensure applications have clear business objectives, target users, success measures, and accountable owners before launch.


**Application Operations and Lifecycle Management**
* Manage the ongoing operational health of production applications.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of fixes, enhancements, and technical improvements based on direction from the application owner.
* Coordinate application updates, testing, release management, and communication to users.
* Help ensure applications remain compatible with changes to models, APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, and security requirements.
* Establish clear escalation paths for defects, incidents, access issues, and performance concerns.
* Maintain accurate documentation for application functionality, dependencies, ownership, and support procedures.


**Feedback, Adoption, and Continuous Improvement**
* Help application owners establish structured feedback loops with users.
* Collect and organize user feedback, feature requests, defects, and usage insights.
* Translate feedback into clear product requirements and backlog items.
* Support application owners in prioritizing improvements based on user value, business impact, risk, and effort.
* Coordinate user testing and validation before major releases.
* Identify common patterns across applications that could inform shared standards, reusable components, or broader AI Ops priorities.


**Measurement and Analytics**
* Develop and maintain dashboards that provide application owners with visibility into adoption, usage, reliability, performance, and business outcomes.
* Define appropriate metrics for each application, including active users, usage frequency, task completion, response quality, errors, latency, user satisfaction, and estimated time or cost savings.
* Monitor application health and surface risks, adoption gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with application owners to review performance regularly and agree on actions.
* Help determine whether applications should be expanded, redesigned, consolidated, or retired based on evidence.


**Governance, Standards, and Portfolio Management**
* Apply AI Ops standards for application development, production readiness, responsible AI, security, documentation, and measurement.
* Help create reusable templates, checklists, playbooks, and operating procedures for agentic coding applications.
* Support the development of a governed application portfolio and inventory.
* Ensure applications have clear ownership, approved data access, defined user groups, and appropriate controls.
* Promote consistency across applications while allowing teams to move quickly and iterate.


**Key Outcomes**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**
* Increased percentage of high\-value prototypes successfully moved into production.
* Reduced time from prototype completion to production launch.
* Stronger production readiness and fewer post\-launch issues.
* Clear ownership and support models for every production application.
* Consistent visibility into application adoption, reliability, and business impact.
* Faster response to user feedback and application issues.
* Increased adoption and sustained usage of production applications.
* A well\-managed portfolio of applications aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Experience in application operations, technical program management, product operations, product management, or a closely related role.
* Strong ability to coordinate work across business, product, engineering, IT, security, and data teams.
* Experience taking internal digital products, AI applications, or technology solutions from prototype through production launch.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical and operational requirements.
* Strong backlog management, prioritization, documentation, and release management skills.
* Experience defining product metrics and building or managing performance dashboards.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving tools, standards, and priorities


**Preferred**
* Experience with AI\-assisted software development, low\-code tools, or agentic coding platforms.
* Familiarity with modern AI models, APIs, agents, workflow automation, and application architectures.
* Experience working with enterprise security, privacy, identity, access management, and software governance processes.
* Familiarity with analytics tools, application monitoring, user telemetry, and experimentation.
* Experience supporting internal enterprise applications or employee productivity tools.
* Working knowledge of software development practices, including testing, deployment, version control, and incident management.


**Core Capabilities**
* Application operations and lifecycle management
* Technical program management
* Stakeholder coordination
* Production readiness
* Backlog and release management
* User feedback, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Application analytics and measurement
* Risk and dependency management
* Technical fluency
* Clear communication and documentation


**Role Profile**
 This role is well suited for someone who enjoys turning early\-stage prototypes into dependable, scalable applications. They are comfortable operating between business and technology teams, creating structure where processes are still developing, and helping application owners make decisions based on user feedback and performance data.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be practical, organized, technically curious, and focused on measurable outcomes. They will know when to move quickly, when to slow down to address risk, and how to keep application owners and technical teams aligned throughout the application lifecycle.
   

  

**Company Summary**
 Zeta Global is a data\-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi\-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2\.4B\+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

title: Product Planning Manager
description:
Global NPU Business \| Secure Connected Edge Processing
   

  

 Are you a strategy‑driven problem solver with a passion for shaping long‑term business direction in fast‑moving technology markets? Join us as
 **Product Planning Manager** 
 and play a critical role in defining and driving the long‑term strategy for NXP’s Global NPU business within the Secure Connected Edge Processing Business Line.

 for the NPU business. You will translate complex market, customer, and competitive signals into clear insights, structured recommendations, and actionable plans that guide portfolio strategy, roadmap priorities, and investment decisions.
   

  

 You will operate at both the
 **30,000‑foot strategy level** 
 and the
 **ground‑truth execution level** 
 , ensuring that long‑term strategy is tightly connected to product roadmaps, go‑to‑market plans, and financial outcomes.

description:

The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.

 Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.

Participate in pre\-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs\-of\-concept, and technical proposals. **Team Management \& Mentorship**
 Lead cross\-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements

**Qualifications**
* 20\+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 10–15 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.

* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**
* 
+ End\-to\-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain\-driven design, and API\-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event\-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands\-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security


**AI Driven Application Development**
* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) \- enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.


**AI\-Enabled Application Development**
* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management \- planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance \- balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.


**Cloud\-Native Architecture (Azure)**

+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
