 Brink’s Global Shared Services Center (GSS) in Hyderabad is a critical enabler of the company’s global transformation and operating model evolution. The center brings together specialized capabilities across Human Resources, Finance, Technology, and other enterprise functions to deliver integrated, end\-to\-end services that support global business priorities.
 



 The center is designed to enable standardized processes, scalable service delivery, and stronger cross\-functional collaboration. Teams in GSS partner closely with global stakeholders to drive efficiency, improve quality, design and scale next generation services, and deliver consistent outcomes across markets.
 



 Hyderabad offers the opportunity to work on complex, high\-impact initiatives, build global exposure, and contribute to the continued evolution of Brink’s operating model.
 



  





**Business Unit Description:** 




 This role sits within IT Operations, a team that plays a key role in supporting Brink’s global technology environment and business continuity.
 



 The function is responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable IT services and infrastructure, partnering across business units, digital teams, and global functions to deliver stable system performance and responsive technology support.
 



 As part of Brink’s global operating model, the team helps drive reliability, resilience, and efficiency, enabling the business to operate securely and without disruption.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 Reporting to the Global Business Applications Lead and Service Delivery Lead, Europe \& Latam \- the GSS IT Ops Business Applications Enhancements Lead is responsible for coordinating the intake, prioritization, delivery, and governance of in\-scope Large IT enhancement requests (between 80 – 500 hours of effort). This role serves as the operational bridge between business stakeholders, Global Shared Services (GSS) IT Operations, Brink’s IT Centers of Excellence (COEs), Brink’s Managed Service Providers (MSP) Enhancement Project Delivery Team to ensure Brink’s business stakeholder approved enhancements are delivered effectively, within agreed timeliness, pre\-agreed quality and cost thresholds. The coordinator drives visibility, governance, reporting, release readiness, and continuous improvement across the enhancement lifecycle across the assigned scope.
 



  





**Work Environment:** 




 At Brink’s, we enable a work environment that supports both performance and flexibility. Work arrangements, including on\-site and hybrid options, will be discussed during the interview process based on role requirements and business needs.
 



 How You’ll Succeed (Roles \& Responsibilities)
 



 Success in this role requires both strong execution and the ability to operate effectively in a global, evolving environment. You will:
 



  





**Enhancement Demand Management:** 



* Coordinate intake (Approved / Prioritized by Global IT/CoE) and triage of enhancement requests or approved demand management tools.
* Validate enhancement requests for completeness, business justification, and categorization.
* Facilitate enhancement sizing, feasibility assessments, and effort estimation activities with MSP(s)
* Maintain enhancement backlogs and support prioritization processes with business and IT stakeholders.
* Monitor enhancement capacity utilization and delivery performance.



  





**Operational Governance:** 



* Schedule and facilitate enhancement review boards, backlog grooming sessions, and prioritization meetings, ensuring the proper utilization/prioritization of the MSP resources (based on a 90 days “rolling” forecast .
* Track enhancement progress from request through deployment and closure.
* Maintain governance artifacts, status reports, risk logs, and action registers.
* Ensure adherence to IT governance, change management, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
* Escalate delivery risks, resource constraints, and priority conflicts.



  





**Release \& Deployment Coordination:** 



* Support release planning and deployment scheduling activities.
* Coordinate readiness activities across technical teams, business users, and vendors.
* Track testing completion, user acceptance testing (UAT) milestones, and deployment approvals.
* Facilitate stakeholder communications for planned releases, outages, and enhancement deployments.
* Monitor post\-release performance and hyper care activities.



  





**Vendor \& MSP Coordination:** 



* Act as a central coordination point between retained IT teams and managed service providers.
* Monitor SLA compliance related to enhancement delivery and operational support.
* Follow up on enhancement execution, defect remediation, and operational issues.
* Support vendor performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.



  





**Reporting \& Analytics:** 



* Develop and maintain dashboards showing enhancement demand, backlog health, delivery performance, and SLA adherence.
* Produce operational reports for leadership review.
* Track enhancement trends, cycle times, and resource utilization metrics.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve operational efficiency.



  





**Continuous Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to streamline enhancement intake, prioritization, and delivery processes.
* Maintain process documentation, workflows, and knowledge articles.
* Support automation and standardization initiatives.
* Drive lessons learned reviews and improvement actions following major releases.



  





**Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or a related field; Master's degree is a plus.
* 5\+ years of progressive experience in shared services, IT operations, Demand management, Application Development Service Delivery, Data Analytics or transformation roles.
* Experience coordinating IT enhancements, releases, or operational projects.
* Experience working within global or shared services environments.
* Experience interacting with outsourced service providers or MSPs.
* Proven ability to define operating models, governance routines, service performance indicators, controls, and continuous improvement roadmaps.
* Strong experience managing stakeholders across functions, geographies, and seniority levels, with the ability to influence and align priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with experience translating complex operational issues into clear decisions and action plans.
* Ability to manage service quality, capacity, risk, escalation paths, performance reviews, and talent development activities.
* Ability to analyze data, identify root causes, document findings, and propose practical improvement actions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive\-level reporting and presentation capability.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.



  





**Who You Are (Skills / Qualifications):** 




**Must Have Skills:** 



* **Enhancement Demand \& Portfolio Management** 
 (e.g., Enhancement Intake \& Demand Management, Backlog Management \& Prioritization, Capacity Planning \& Forecasting, Requirements Validation \& Business Case Review, Enhancement Sizing \& Effort Estimation, Resource Utilization Management, Portfolio Governance \& Reporting)
* **IT Service Management \& Governance** 
 (e.g., ITIL\-Based Service Management, Change Management, Release Management, Governance Board Facilitation, Risk \& Issue Management, SLA Management, Operational Reporting \& KPI Management, Escalation Management)
* **Business Applications Delivery** 
 (e.g., Application Enhancement Lifecycle Management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Coordination, Deployment Readiness Reviews, Hypercare Management, Defect Remediation Tracking, Business Stakeholder Engagement, Cross\-Functional Coordination)
* **Vendor \& MSP Management** 
 (e.g., MSP Governance, Vendor Performance Management, Delivery Oversight, Contracted Service Monitoring, Resource Planning with Service Providers, Service Review Facilitation)
* **Reporting \& Analytics** 
 (e.g., Dashboard Development, Performance Metrics Tracking, Backlog Health Analysis, Delivery Performance Reporting, Trend Analysis, Executive Status Reporting)
* **Stakeholder Management**
* **Experience in Core Platforms** 
 (e.g., ServiceNow, Power BI)



  





**Good to Have Skills:** 



* **Enterprise Application Experience** 
 (e.g., ERP Platforms (Oracle, Sage, Dynamics), HR Systems (Workday), Finance Applications, Procurement Platforms (Coupa), CRM Platforms, Integration Platforms \& APIs (Informatica, MuleSoft))
* **Agile \& Product Delivery** 
 (e.g., Agile Delivery Methodologies, Scrum Practices, Release Trains \& Sprint Planning, Continuous Delivery Practices)
* **Security \& Compliance Awareness** 
 (e.g., SDLC Controls, SOX Compliance Awareness, Audit Support, Application Security Fundamentals, Data Privacy \& Compliance, Change Governance Controls)

 in ITIL Foundation / Managing Professional (MP), PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum (CSM, PSM), SAFe Agilist, or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* **Experience in ServiceNow SPM**



  





**What Brink’s Offers:**

* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for the execution of change programs. We rely on our team’s expertise and specialisms to engage with executive\-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Salesforce Consultant with expertise in Commerce Cloud B2B and Order Management System (OMS) to provide our clients with strategic guidance, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and hands\-on technical consulting experience in a major software domain, along with proficiency in both English and French languages.
   

  

**Technical consultants** 
 demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of solutions, including enterprise integrations using middleware tools and platforms. As such, they are responsible for the analysis of options and subsequent presentations and education of the customer/partner. They will also identify and proactively handle risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through completion.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into Salesforce solutions leveraging Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS).
* Design, configure, and customize Salesforce solutions to meet client needs, including but not limited to product catalog management, pricing, quoting, and order management processes.
* Lead Salesforce implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment. Provide ongoing support and maintenance for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS) implementations, including troubleshooting issues and optimizing system performance.
* Develop and deliver training sessions and documentation for clients to enable them to effectively utilize Salesforce solutions.
* Stay current on Salesforce best practices and industry trends, particularly related to Commerce Cloud B2B and OMS, and proactively share knowledge with internal teams and clients.
* Work independently and as part of a distributed team, taking ownership of problems and rapidly learning new technologies.
* Build and maintain key relationships with key decision\-makers, demonstrating strong presentation, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Available to travel regionally and occasionally internationally depending on customer needs.
* Champion an AI\-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limit compliance
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize daily development velocity, document custom code, and maintain strict platform security standards
* Contribute to broader goals by becoming a citizen philanthropist and giving back to our communities through volunteering activities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience working with Salesforce, with a focus on Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS), or equivalent experience in a similar role.
* Proven track record of successful Salesforce implementations, including experience with full project lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce integrations, including third\-party systems and APIs, is preferred.

title: Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Mgmt
description:
**About Sanofi**
 At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI\-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting\-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life\-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.
   

  

 Our Team: Process Enablement Platforms
   

  

 The Process Enablement Platforms team within Digital Tech is at the heart of Sanofi's digital transformation. We design, build, and operate the foundational technology platforms that enable seamless business processes across our 70\+ manufacturing sites, clinical facilities, laboratories, and corporate locations in over 50 countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent automation, data\-driven insights, and world\-class platform engineering.
   

  

 We're responsible for core platforms and products that sustain Digital Technologies and part of Business Processes, covering ServiceNow, Configuration Management Database (CMDB), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Asset and Hardware Management, and the data infrastructure that powers AI\-assisted IT Service Management. We don't just maintain platform, we architect the future of how Sanofi manages its technology landscape, ensuring every asset, configuration item, and service relationship is discoverable, traceable, and optimized for automation and AI consumption.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Management, you will be a technical leader and hands\-on architect responsible for evolving Sanofi's CMDB, Discovery, and configuration data ecosystem into an AI\-ready, data\-centric foundation. This is not a traditional ServiceNow administration role, this is a strategic technical leadership position that bridges platform engineering, data management, AI integration, and DevOps.
   

  

 You will lead a team of developers, drive technical excellence, and champion the transformation from configuration management to intelligent data operations. You'll work at the intersection of ServiceNow, Snowflake, Generative AI, and modern data platforms, building integrations via APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP), harmonizing data across systems, and implementing automation that challenges the status quo.
   

  

 This role demands a proactive problem\-solver who can code, architect, mentor, and lead, someone equally comfortable designing and implementing data models, writing scripts, configuring ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mappings, and collaborating with AI engineers to build next\-generation capabilities.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

**Technical Leadership \& Development**
* Lead the design, development, and optimization of ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM capabilities
* Architect and implement data integrations between ServiceNow, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and application\-to\-application (A2A) patterns
* Develop automation scripts and workflows using JavaScript, Python, or other scripting languages to enhance platform capabilities and data quality
* Design and maintain data structures, schemas, and harmonization logic to ensure consistency across configuration, asset, and infrastructure data
* Leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, GPT models) and AI algorithms to automate discovery, classification, relationship mapping, and anomaly detection
* Implement DevOps practices for platform development, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployment across development, test, and production environments


**CMDB \& Data Management Excellence**
* Own the strategy and execution of CMDB maturity, ensuring alignment with Common Service Data Model (CSDM) standards
* Drive automated discovery and service mapping across hybrid cloud, on\-premises, and SaaS environments
* Establish data quality frameworks, KPIs, and governance processes to maintain high\-integrity configuration and asset data
* Technically and processually lead Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) initiatives, ensuring compliance and optimization
* Define and implement data harmonization strategies to integrate CMDB data with Snowflake, data lakes, and analytics platforms


**Product \& Roadmap Ownership**
* Define and prioritize the product roadmap for Platforms Configurations and Data Management in collaboration with stakeholders
* Manage the full product lifecycle: ideation, development, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, IT Strategy, and business process owners to align platform capabilities with strategic initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies (AI/ML, DataOps, AIOps) and integrate them into the platform strategy


**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and data specialists, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning
* Organize and prioritize team workload, remove blockers, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions
* Act as a technical point of contact and subject matter expert for CMDB, Discovery, ITOM, and data management
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Infrastructure, Operations, Security, Compliance, and AI/Data Science teams
* Drive change management initiatives, challenging existing processes and championing data\-driven, automated approaches


**About You**
**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field
* Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with CMDB, including automated Discovery, Service Mapping, and asset management in complex, global environments
* ServiceNow Expertise: Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and CSDM implementation
* Data \& Integration Skills: Proven experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), API development (REST, GraphQL), data harmonization, and integration patterns (MCP, A2A)
* Development Proficiency: Coding skills in JavaScript, Python, or similar scripting languages; proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation
* DevOps Knowledge: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated deployment practices
* Software \& Asset Management: Hands\-on experience with SAM and HAM processes, tools, and compliance frameworks
* Industry Standards: Solid understanding of CSDM, ITIL, and IT asset management best practices
* Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile environments with product management principles (roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, sprint planning)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Education: Postgraduate degree or certification in AI, Data Science, Technology Architecture, or related field
* AI \& Analytics: Experience with Generative AI tools, machine learning algorithms, and AI\-assisted automation
* Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure and cloud\-native discovery tools
* Advanced ServiceNow: ServiceNow certifications (CIS\-Discovery, CIS\-ITOM, CIS\-SAM) or equivalent expertise
* Data Engineering: Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and modern data stack technologies


**Leadership Competencies**
* Proactive \& Innovative: Self\-starter who anticipates challenges, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement
* Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Thinking: Ability to diagnose complex technical and data issues and architect scalable solutions
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaboration \& Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in global, cross\-functional teams across time zones and cultures
* Mentorship \& Development: Passion for coaching and developing team members, fostering technical growth and accountability
* Change Leadership: Comfortable challenging the status quo, driving transformation, and managing resistance to change
* Results\-Oriented: Track record of delivering high\-impact outcomes in fast\-paced, dynamic environments


 Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary
   

  

 Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
   

  

 At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
   

  

 Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and evolve our marketing technology and email lifecycle platform. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, marketing operations, and data privacy driving the roadmap for our Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) ecosystem, email campaign platforms, and consent/preference management (including OneTrust Preference Center) while contributing to broader digital marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with hands\-on technical fluency in SFMC, email marketing best practices, and privacy\-compliant customer communication frameworks.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end product roadmap for the email marketing and marketing automation platform (SFMC), aligning with business goals and customer engagement strategy.
* Partner with marketing, CRM, legal, and compliance teams to design and manage subscription and consent workflows using OneTrust Preference Center.
* Define and prioritize product requirements (PRDs/user stories) for email journeys, automation workflows, and personalization capabilities within SFMC.
* Collaborate with engineering and MarTech teams to integrate SFMC, OneTrust, and other digital marketing tools into a unified customer data and communication ecosystem.
* Drive consent management and preference center enhancements to ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, CAN\-SPAM, and other global privacy regulations.
* Analyze campaign performance, deliverability metrics, and subscriber preference data to identify opportunities for optimization.
* Lead cross\-functional stakeholder alignment across Marketing, Legal, Data Privacy, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for email engagement, list health, opt\-in/opt\-out rates, and preference center adoption.
* Support broader digital marketing initiatives including campaign personalization, audience segmentation, and channel orchestration.
* Manage the product backlog, sprint planning, and release cycles in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Stay current with SFMC platform updates, OneTrust feature releases, and evolving data privacy regulations to proactively adapt the roadmap.
* Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content for internal stakeholders on platform capabilities.



**Primary Skills (Must\-Have)** 



* **Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):** 
 Deep hands\-on experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, and Content Builder.
* **OneTrust Preference Center:** 
 Proven experience configuring, managing, or integrating OneTrust Preference Center for subscription management, consent capture, and privacy compliance workflows.
* **Email Campaign Management:** 
 Strong background in designing, executing, and optimizing email marketing campaigns, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and automated journeys.
* **Product Management Fundamentals:** 
 Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum methodologies, product roadmapping, backlog management, and writing clear PRDs/user stories.
* **Requirement Gathering \& Documentation:** 
 Ability to translate business and compliance needs into detailed technical and functional requirements.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 Experience analyzing campaign and platform metrics (open rates, CTR, deliverability, opt\-in/opt\-out trends) to inform product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Demonstrated ability to align Marketing, Legal, Privacy, and Engineering teams around a shared roadmap.
* **Email Deliverability \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, CASL, and email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).



**Secondary Skills (Good\-to\-Have)** 



* **General Digital Marketing:** 
 Familiarity with SEO/SEM, paid social, display advertising, and multi\-channel campaign orchestration.
* **CRM/CDP Familiarity:** 
 Working knowledge of Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud, or customer data platforms (CDPs) that integrate with SFMC.
* **SQL \& AMPscript:** 
 Basic to intermediate scripting skills for data extensions, audience queries, and dynamic content personalization in SFMC.
* **Other ESPs/MAPs:** 
 Exposure to other marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable.
* **Privacy \& Consent Tech Ecosystem:** 
 Awareness of other consent management platforms (CMPs) or privacy tech tools beyond OneTrust.
* **UX/UI Sensibility:** 
 An eye for user experience in designing intuitive preference center and email interaction flows.
* **API \& Integrations Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware tools used to connect SFMC, OneTrust, and other systems.
* **Certifications:** 
 SFMC certifications (Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Consultant) and/or OneTrust certification are a strong plus.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 6–10 years of overall experience, with at least 3\+ years in a Product Manager role focused on MarTech, CRM, or email marketing platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud is required; experience with OneTrust or similar consent/preference management tools is highly preferred.
* Prior experience working in regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare, insurance) with strict data privacy requirements is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams.

description:
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 As a Product Director for the Metrics product area, you will own the strategy and execution for an internally developed enterprise\-wide product suite that serves as the backbone for how JPMorgan Chase measures the health and effectiveness of its products and cross\-functional agile delivery teams. Your platform encompasses the systems\-of\-record that provide executive\-to\-team visibility into delivery performance and organizational health.
   

  

 You will partner closely with engineering, design, data science, customer success, and business leaders to deliver best\-in\-class analytics solutions that drive measurable value. A critical dimension of this role is leading the agentic transformation of the Metrics product area: leveraging agentic tools to accelerate your team's product development lifecycle (PDLC), while simultaneously building next\-generation AI features and capabilities for your users.
   

  

 We're looking for a senior leader who combines deep product management expertise with a forward\-leaning perspective on AI and agentic tooling. You should be someone who can translate complex organizational data into actionable insights and who sees AI not just as a feature set, but as a fundamental accelerant for how products are built and consumed. The core of your role is driving product excellence, data quality, and operational impact across the organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Set Product Vision \& Strategy: Define and communicate a bold product vision and roadmap for the Metrics product area. Define and align the feature roadmap with organizational objectives, with a clear through\-line to JPMC's agentic transformation strategy.
* Measure Success: Establish, track, and continuously refine Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the Metrics product area to ensure product initiatives deliver measurable impact, drive alignment across teams, and support ongoing improvement.
* Lead Cross\-Functional Teams: Inspire and guide cross\-functional teams of product managers, UI/UX designers, software engineers, and data scientists to deliver innovative analytics solutions at scale, spanning APIs, data pipelines, modern web interfaces, and AI\-powered experiences.
* Drive Agile Execution: Champion agile methodologies, ensuring effective prioritization, sprint planning, and delivery of high\-value experiences. Model the same agile discipline your products measure.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong relationships with senior executives, delivery leads, engineering leaders, Line of Business Product \& Technology leaders, and control functions who depend on these platforms for quarterly business reviews, capacity planning, and organizational health assessments.
* Customer\-Centric Innovation: Collaborate with UX research and customer success functions to identify pain points and opportunities. Translate insights into actionable product enhancements that surface the "so what" behind the metrics.
* Operational Excellence: Oversee backlog health, testing, production readiness, and continuous improvement of product development processes. Ensure platform reliability for a user base that depends on these metrics for executive decision\-making.
* Mentor \& Develop Talent: Build and nurture a high\-performing product management team, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and growth.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, including leadership of complex, cross\-functional initiatives; bachelor's degree preferred.
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise\-scale data, analytics, or business intelligence products in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
* Deep familiarity with agile delivery metrics and frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, etc.). Not just as a practitioner, but as someone who understands how to measure and improve them at organizational scale.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with AI/agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate product development workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a strategic, ownership mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear product direction.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence at all levels, from teams to C\-suite\-level stakeholders.
* Proficiency with product management, data and analytics tools (e.g., Jira, Adobe Analytics, Figma, Qualtrics, Databricks).
* Commitment and self\-motivation suitable to a startup\-pace team operating within a large financial institution.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building internal, multi\-tenant enterprise platforms.
* Background in data products, data pipelines, or analytics platforms. Comfort with concepts like data aggregation, ETL, caching strategies, and API\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks (microservices, event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native platforms) sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Experience with cohort analysis, benchmarking methodologies, or statistical process control in a product context.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. title: IT Business Relationship Partner
description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The
 **Business Relationship Partner** 
 within the IT and Digital Services (IDS) department plays an important role in bridging the gap between technology and business objectives. Working within the BRM team this role is responsible for understanding the strategic needs of a given business unit and translating them into business outcomes, ensuring alignment with the business domain and/or value stream on the overall True North, purpose and goals. The Business Partner will collaborate closely with value stream leaders, sponsors, IDS delivery teams and other technical teams to develop roadmaps and shape demand of new initiatives. This role is non operational and requires analytical broad perspective thinking but with the ability to convert and conclude larger business outcomes into strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Build strong network and relationships within the business functional teams and/or value streams, understand the business objectives and work to identify Minimal Viable Products to validate business hypothesis statements to ensure value is created.
* Communicate effectively to ensure the successful implementation of the most valuable investments, recognizing that not all initiatives may proceed.
* Identify opportunities to adopt existing technology or identify opportunities for new innovation that still align with larger strategic objectives by collaborating with the Enterprise Architecture team.
* Develop a knowledge of the business units or value streams long\-term goals and objectives while creating awareness within IDS of strategic business outcomes
* Contribute to the development of IDS and BRM strategies that support business goals and objectives by collaborating with enterprise architecture.
* Work closely with enterprise architecture to develop and maintain multi\-year technology capability roadmaps to support the business plan and business capability development
* Work closely with PMO to ensure a healthy and well\-managed initiative portfolio and align to Lean Portfolio Management best practices.
* Responsible for gathering cost base for initiatives and building high quality and reliable business cases leveraging Proof of Concepts and Minimum Viable Products to validate hypothesis statements.
* Communicate with all stakeholders to ensure the adoption of initiatives, be actively involved in ensuring the value is measured and recorded, and identifying and measuring leading indicators for each initiative
* Partner with the delivery teams to execute the investment portfolio, focus on business value instead of solutions.
* Collaborate with other business partners and business relationship managers to identify cross\-functional opportunities and challenges
* Constructively work within the wider IDS team to ensure business knowledge is cascaded to the delivery teams. Promote the value of IDS and engage positively to ensure appropriate recognition.


**You Are Meant For This Job If**
* Recognized University Degree in IT or technology related subject or proven relevant experience
* Self\-motivated with a strong ability to rely on intuition and problem\-solving skills to enhance the deliverables of the BRM department.
* 6 to 8 years experience within IT / Software Services / Technology related discipline
* Excellent awareness of IT market \& technology changes. Ideally within the Energy industry.
* Change management facilitation and ability to guide and influence acceptance of new processes and use of technology. This includes the people side of change to influence a sponsor coalition and employee managers
* Ability to balance user, stakeholder and technical needs within budgets and demanding timelines
* Business analytical skills (numerical, analytical and critical thinking skills)
* Proficiency in articulating intricate issues in a clear and non\-technical manner (written and verbal)
* Willingness to learn and adapt to a LEAN and Agile mindset
* Ability to identify strategic initiatives and develop long\-term roadmaps with the value streams and/or business domains
* Fluency in spoken and written English is a prerequisite, encompassing listening, comprehension, reading, and writing skills.

 Strategy Development

 Business Process Modeling

title: Program Management (Technical), Principal
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years managing technical programs where the stakes are real: a missed milestone means a customer's tape\-out slips, a miscommunication means a silicon spin, and a poorly managed risk means millions of dollars and months of schedule lost. You know that program management in the IP world is not about status reports, it is about being the person who sees around corners, catches the integration issue before it becomes a blocker, and keeps a dozen moving parts aligned across time zones and organizations.
   

  

 You are comfortable sitting in a room with a customer's SoC architect talking through their power budget and walking out with a clear plan for how your IP fits their roadmap. You do not wait for perfect information. You ask the right questions, synthesize what matters, and drive decisions that keep programs moving. You have managed enough programs to know when a schedule is real and when it is wishful thinking, and you are not afraid to escalate early.
   

  

 You think in terms of outcomes, not activities. You care about whether the customer gets to tape\-out on time with IP that works, not whether your slides look polished. At Synopsys, you will work with tier\-one customers on programs that define the next generation of SoCs, and the IP portfolio you manage will end up in products that ship at scale.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end IP development programs for tier\-one customers, from initial requirements through silicon bring\-up, ensuring delivery against committed schedules and specifications
* Serve as the primary technical and operational point of contact between customers and Synopsys cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, FAE, CAE, and R\&D
* Plan and drive program schedules across standard IP deliveries, custom IP development, and foundry process technology node transitions
* Identify, track, and escalate technical and schedule risks, driving issues to resolution across internal development teams and external customer stakeholders
* Coordinate IP integration activities with customer SoC design teams, ensuring successful acquisition, integration, and silicon validation
* Translate customer SoC requirements into actionable development plans, working with R\&D to align IP roadmaps with customer product timelines
* Communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders at multiple levels, from engineering teams to executive leadership


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to meet their SoC tape\-out schedules by delivering IP on time and to specification, directly affecting their product launch timelines
* Reduce customer integration risk by proactively identifying and resolving technical issues before they impact silicon bring\-up
* Expand Synopsys IP footprint in customer roadmaps by identifying opportunities for future SoC programs based on deep program engagement
* Improve cross\-functional execution by creating clarity across geographically distributed teams, reducing miscommunication and rework
* Strengthen customer relationships through consistent delivery and technical credibility, turning program success into long\-term partnerships
* Influence internal IP development priorities by bringing customer voice and real\-world integration challenges back to R\&D teams
* Shape how Synopsys executes complex, high\-stakes programs by setting the standard for technical program management in the Silicon IP business


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 10 to 15\+ years of relevant experience in program management or technical leadership roles
* Proven track record managing programs in analog and digital SoC design environments, with demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical programs on schedule
* Deep knowledge of IC manufacturing, process technology, design flow, and sign\-off processes, with the ability to speak credibly with customer engineering teams
* Understanding of memory and standard cell design, including how IP integrates into SoC design flows and what can go wrong during integration
* Experience working directly with customers in a technical or program capacity, managing expectations and navigating complex stakeholder environments
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with competing priorities, making clear trade\-off decisions and keeping teams aligned
* Strong technical communication skills, you can explain a complex integration issue to a customer architect and translate it into an actionable plan for internal R\&D


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to their SoC requirements, and come out with a clear understanding of what they actually need versus what they said they need
* You know when to escalate and when to solve, and you do not let issues sit hoping they will resolve themselves
* You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, you can start a program with incomplete requirements and drive the right conversations to fill in the gaps without stalling progress
* You manage up and down effectively, keeping executives informed without over\-communicating and keeping engineering teams focused without micromanaging
* You have the technical depth to challenge an unrealistic schedule or a risky integration approach, and the credibility to make that challenge stick
* You think about the customer's success as your success, and you take ownership of program outcomes even when the path to get there is messy


**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

title: Analyst II, Network Strategy and Performance
description:
**Description**
 As an Analyst within the Network Strategy Performance team, you will own analytics that directly shape where and how Amazon serves customers globally. You will model network scenarios spanning 100\+ sites across 40\+ countries, inform multi\-year investment decisions, and deliver insights that influence headcount allocation, site strategy, and contact routing for one of the world's largest customer service networks.
   

  

 This isn't a reporting role — you'll tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes questions: Where should we expand next? How do we balance cost\-to\-serve against customer experience across geographies? What's the optimal site mix for the next three years? Your analysis will flow directly into monthly, OP and 3YP cycles that leadership uses to allocate resources.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Operations, Products, FP\&A, and Service Delivery teams — identifying gaps, measuring performance, and driving automation and process improvement initiatives. You will contribute to the team's AI\-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own analytical inputs for network planning — model contact allocation scenarios, site investment options, and capacity strategies across geographies. Build and maintain the frameworks that determine how millions of weekly customer contacts are distributed across the global CS network, coordinating with Finance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure alignment with cost and CX targets.
* Translate complex or ambiguous network strategy questions into structured analysis — e.g., site expansion feasibility, cost\-to\-serve trade\-offs, regional performance variance. Dive into the heart of ambiguous problems with non\-defined inputs and outputs, identify root causes driving site or network\-level performance gaps, and derive recommendations that influence headcount allocation, site investment, and network architecture decisions.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
description:
**Our Company** 
  

  

 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes.  In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.
   

  

 Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.
   

  

 Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise\-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.

 On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next\-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.
   

  

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of product management experience, including 6\+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air\-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.

**What You Will Bring**

* Hands\-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud\-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance\-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next\-generation backup architectures, AI\-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise\-ready.

 Senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. * Own the Architecture and drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI\-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.


**Engineering Excellence**
* Champion high\-quality engineering practices across all delivery engagements.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance benchmarks.
* Define and institutionalize engineering guardrails that embed secure coding, test‑driven development, observability.
* Encourage continuous learning and technical certifications to maintain cutting\-edge expertise.
* Drive adoption of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) to ensure robust and scalable solutions.
* Foster a culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability within the team.


**Innovation \& Thought Leadership**
* Monitor and evaluate emerging technologies to inform strategic direction.
* Lead innovation in delivery models, reusable assets, and accelerators to enhance efficiency and impact.
* Champion modern thinking and best practices across teams and engagements to foster a culture of continuous improvement.


**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
* Use design thinking to shape user‑centric solutions, aligning business goals, architecture decisions, and delivery execution.
* Engage with clients to understand business needs and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning efforts with estimations, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical proposals.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and value delivery.


**Team Management \& Mentorship**
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.
* Conduct reviews, provide feedback, and support professional development of team members.


**Quality \& Compliance**
* Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.


**Strategic Partnering**
* Serve as a strategic partner for internal and external stakeholders on key initiatives.
* Provide strategic guidance and execution oversight to ensure alignment with organizational goals.

* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and team leadership skills.

+ Hands‑on data and platform fundamentals, including relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), performance tuning, scalability, resiliency, and application security

title: Senior Manager - CRM Innovation & Experimentation
description:
**Summary**
 Novartis is on a mission to transform medicine and improve lives worldwide. As a global leader in healthcare, we leverage advanced technology, data, and digital capabilities to deliver patient\-centric solutions, enhance customer engagement, and drive innovation. Within this context, the US CRM organization plays a critical role in shaping the transformation to next\-generation CRM Innovation Labs that identifies and tests opportunities that can improve customer engagement, user experience, productivity, and CRM capabilities. Its work combines structured discovery, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based recommendations.
   

  

 The Senior Manager, CRM Innovation \& Experimentation leads defined innovation opportunities and experiments within the Hyderabad Labs extension. Reporting to the Director, CRM Enablement, Hyderabad, the role partners with the Associate Director, CRM Innovation Labs, US Labs leadership, Product Owners, business teams, technology partners, and control functions to scout emerging possibilities, run prototypes and proofs of concept, coordinate internal and external contributors, and convert learning into decision\-ready recommendations.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Senior Manager \- CRM Innovation \& Experimentation**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**
* Explore business challenges, user needs, product gaps, market trends, and emerging technologies to identify relevant CRM opportunities.
* Scout and assess startups, technology providers, specialist partners, and external capabilities against defined business needs and experiment objectives.
* Triage opportunities to determine whether they require experimentation, can reuse existing CRM capabilities, or should be redirected to another accountable team.
* Shape selected opportunities into clear problem statements, hypotheses, expected benefits, success measures, assumptions, risks, and decision criteria.
* Lead timeboxed discovery, prototyping, proof\-of\-concept, user validation, and technical feasibility activities, ensuring required data, environments, integrations, access, and specialist support are in place.
* Coordinate cross\-functional contributors, including Product Owners, business SMEs, UX, architecture, engineering, data, analytics, privacy, security, legal, compliance, procurement, delivery teams, contractors, and external partners.
* Synthesize user, business, technical, operational, and market evidence into recommendations to advance, pivot, pause, stop, or transition opportunities, including reuse, configuration, process change, or existing\-product enhancement options.
* Maintain strong execution discipline and governance through experiment plans, backlogs, decision records, risks, dependencies, stakeholder updates, transition\-ready documentation, reusable insights, and compliance with responsible\-use, data, privacy, security, legal, procurement, and documentation requirements.


**Essential Requirements**
* Quality and timeliness of opportunity briefs, experiment plans, prototypes, evidence packs, and recommendations.
* Clarity of hypotheses, benefit measures, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and decision records.
* Speed of learning and reduction of business, user, technical, operational, or compliance uncertainty.
* Relevance and quality of external capabilities assessed or translated into experiments.
* Effectiveness of stakeholder and contractor coordination, deliverables, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Quality and readiness of handovers into product roadmaps, operational capabilities, or other agreed adoption pathways.


**Educational Requirement**
 Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, life sciences, engineering, or a related field is required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred
   

  

**Minimum Experience**
* 9\+ years of experience in digital innovation, product management, consulting, technology scouting, prototyping, CRM, or related disciplines.
* Hands\-on experience shaping ambiguous opportunities and leading experiments from hypothesis through evidence\-based recommendation.
* Experience evaluating startups, technology providers, vendors, or external capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional workstreams, contractors, or specialist partners.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder\-management, and execution capabilities.
* Experience working in agile, product\-oriented, global, or distributed environments.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated industry is desirable.


**Desirable Requirement**
**Navigate Complexity** 
 \- Convert ambiguous opportunities into focused experiments and clear decisions.
   

  

**Deliver Collective Impact**

 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
   

  

 As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI\-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool\-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre\-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real\-world performance metrics.
   

  

 Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the end\-to\-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi\-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre\-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. description:

 Techdome is hiring someone to operate as an extension of the CEO and CTO — turning high\-level strategic discussions into tangible, executed outcomes. This isn't a support role; it's a role built for someone who can take a half\-formed idea from a leadership conversation and walk out with a plan, a timeline, and a person accountable for each piece. You'll work across Engineering, Marketing, BD, and Ops to keep priorities moving from "we should do this" to "this is done," and you'll constantly be looking for places where AI and automation can replace manual, repetitive work across the business.

* Flag recurring manual work — research, reporting, documentation — and build AI\-driven or automated fixes for it

* A track record of operating effectively without a pre\-built playbook
* High ownership — you notice what's missing and fix it before someone has to ask
* Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, sometimes within the same week

* Fluency in using AI tools as a natural part of daily work, not a bolt\-on
* Sound judgment around confidential information, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing track of details


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience in a startup or founder's office, particularly under high\-pressure conditions
* Exposure to client\-facing work or business development
* Working familiarity with tools like Notion, Asana, or Trello
* Some understanding of how AI, SaaS, Healthcare, Fintech, or Enterprise Tech companies operate
* An MBA is a nice\-to\-have, but a demonstrated bias for execution matters far more


**Why Join Techdome?**
* End\-to\-end exposure to strategy, technology, AI, BD, client relationships, and operations — with genuine ownership, not a front\-row seat
* Direct, regular access to the CEO and CTO and a place in the room where real decisions get made
* Cross\-functional scope across the entire business — nothing pre\-packaged, nowhere to coast
* A clear growth path into a broader leadership or strategy role as you demonstrate impact


**What Success Looks Like**
 You'll know you're succeeding if strategic ideas consistently turn into finished outcomes on your watch — the right people get chased down, the right blockers get cleared, and nothing important slips through.

 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 









**Senior Staff Product Manager – Technical (Data \& Audience Platform Team), Hyderabad** 








 About Warner Bros. Discovery:
 
 Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non\-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.
 



 For more information, please visit
 **www.wbd.com** 
 .
 



  


**Meet our team** 




 The Data and Audience Platform team sits within the Data \& Analytics organization in WBD's Global Tech division. We build the data platform behind our streaming services and content businesses \- the pipelines, data lakes, and serving infrastructure that turn billions of events into audience insights, personalization, and intelligent products.
   

  
   


**About the Role**




 The Senior Staff Product Manager\-Tech, AI/ML Roadmap and Platform Strategy, will define and drive the Data \& Audience Platform (DAP) AI roadmap across predictive ML, GenAI, agentic workflows, AI\-enabled analytics, data activation, and AI\-native platform capabilities. This role is intentionally AI\-centric: it exists to elevate DAP from a data and analytics platform organization into a product\-led AI enablement function that identifies the highest\-value AI opportunities, chooses the right technologies, and converts experimentation into durable business outcomes.
 







 This role will be accountable for disciplined AI product strategy: selecting the right problems, validating that the newest technology is actually the best fit, defining measurable business value up front, and ensuring platform investments are reusable, governed, cost\-aware, and scalable. The role will work across DAP, engineering, analytics, data science, architecture, product, operations, privacy/legal, AI governance, and senior leadership to make AI investments actionable, safe, and outcome driven.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* Shape AI product strategy and roadmap priorities across DAP platform areas.
* Evaluate AI/ML opportunities through value, feasibility, cost, data readiness, governance, and reuse lenses.
* Write AI\-focused PRDs, product briefs, model/agent behavior requirements, evaluation criteria, and launch readiness requirements.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and architecture to compare model, platform, vendor, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Define KPIs and decision frameworks that connect AI outputs to business outcomes.
* Run AI roadmap, prioritization, value review, and post\-launch measurement forums.
* Translate complex AI/ML concepts into clear executive narratives and actionable decisions.
* Identify when AI work should be standardized as a shared platform capability versus delivered as a bespoke solution.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to intake, define, identify risks, and schedule work to develop key features.
* Formulate a point of view on how proposed features align with business goals and our tech strategy.



  


**What to Bring:** 



* 12\+ years of product management, technical product management, AI/ML product strategy, data platform, analytics, or related experience.

title: Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Applied AI Senior Product Specialist
   

  

 An Applied AI Senior Product Specialist is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-function al product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cas h learning loop—automatin g analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—am plified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

* Product Accountability
* Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
* Drive strategy\-align ed solutions to achieve product value objectives.
* Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
* Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
* Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Vision and Strategy
* Co\-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
* Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
* Co\-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.
* Market and User Engagement
* Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelera ting the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
* Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Work side\-by\-side with cross\-function al (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
* Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
* Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.
* Continuous Improvement
* Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
* Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
* Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force\-multipli er to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
* Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.
* Applied AI Ways of Working
* Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—char ting new pathways for the business rather than only collecting requirements.
* Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compre ssing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
* Amplify focus: act as Editor\-in\-Chie f—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
* Amplify experimentatio n: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.


 The successful candidate will possess:
   

  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


 The team
   

  

 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI\-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this t ransformation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of proven experience in product management or related roles.
* 1\+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1\+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 0\-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sec tors you serve
* Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week
* Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select location available for this role


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience being accountable for value and viability results for an empowered product team.
* Experience in modern product craft of delivering the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Experience in modern product management craft and domain (tools, methods, and practices).
* Experience with lean solutions and rapid, inexpensive experimentatio n to emerge the right thing, in the right way, at the right time.
* Accountability for value, viability and P\&L objectives for a product.
* Quick to reach expert\-level knowledge within the product domain being served.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and derive actionable insights.
* Problem\-Solvin g: Innovative and experimental approach to solving complex problems.
* Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire cross\-function al teams, fostering collaboration and collective movement toward product goals.
* Customer\-Centr icity: Deep understanding of customer needs and engagement patterns, driving teams to deliver solutions that customers love and that work for the business.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for the product, aligning it with broader business objectives.
* AI Agentic Fluency: Comfortable orchestrating multiple AI agents across the concept\-to\-cas h flow (research, insight, prototyping, specification, coding, and compliance), with guardrails at each hand\-off—assum ptions, confidence levels, and links to sources of truth.
* AI Realism and Eval Fluency: Understands the difference between deterministic logic and probabilistic generation; designs guardrails for hallucination, bias, and drift; uses evaluation harnesses before launch and monitors drift after, with a kill\-switch mentality—and knows when not to use AI.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges.
