title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Direct Payments
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations**
 Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.
   

  

 We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead our efforts in integrating and optimising national payment scheme integrations across the APAC region. This role will focus on expanding Wise’s reach through new payment scheme integrations while continuously improving the performance of existing scheme integrations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Understand customer needs: Build an understanding of how payment schemes impact our customers, and use this understanding to drive product decisions.
* Determine the strategy for Wise’s payment scheme integrations: Work with internal teams, regulators, and payment scheme operators in order to build a multi\-year roadmap of which payment scheme functionality Wise should be connected to. Lobby for changes to payment schemes to make our customers' lives better.
* Lead payment scheme integrations: Alongside engineering leads, you’ll be managing technical integrations with payment schemes. This will include working with multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring strong project management is in place, identifying risks and opportunities early and adapting to them.
* Monitor and optimise: Use data to track the performance of integrations and drive continuous improvement.
* Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost\-efficiency of the scheme integration.


**Qualifications**
**What You’ll Bring**
* Significant product management experience in payments, ideally in finance/fintech.
+ 8\+ years in the workforce with ideally 5\+ years in product management or product\-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3\+ years in a senior product manager role

* A knack for project management: This is not a project manager role, but payment scheme integrations have many moving parts and you will be accountable for the team’s success.
* Analytical mindset: Ability to use data to make informed decisions and track performance metrics.
* Customer focus: A passion for building products that solve real customer problems.
* A strong track record shipping customer\-facing products end\-to\-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade\-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with payment scheme integrations
* Experience in fintech or a high\-growth tech company.
* The ability to write SQL
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Product Manager, AI Data & Insight Products
description:
**Overview**
**About JAGGAER:**
 JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.JAGGAER is the leader in autonomous commerce, delivering AI\-powered Source\-to\-Pay solutions that connect buyers, suppliers, and partners across the globe. JAI, our intelligence and execution layer, is the centrepiece of JAGGAER's AI strategy: enabling procurement teams to work smarter, move faster, and drive measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Director of Product Management, JAI
   

  

**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue\-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.
   

  

 The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI\-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.
   

  

 You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.
   

  

 This is a strategy and delivery role in a single seat. You will set the direction, and you will be measured on what ships against it.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Product ownership: Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the data products built on them.
* AI\-native insight capabilities: Define and deliver new AI capabilities in this space, including generated insight and anomaly detection across customer spend, taking them from concept through early access to general availability.
* Product direction: Define what analytics and data products become as AI absorbs them, including how customers consume data when their own systems and agents are the consumer rather than a person, and where the boundary sits between surfacing an insight and acting on it. Establish the product direction for agent\-ready data delivery.
* Data trust and accuracy: Own the quality bar for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over: the definitions of core procurement measures, the evaluation approach that proves accuracy, and the standard a model must meet before it is used with a customer.
* Committed delivery: Meet the existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments already sold to customers, including those carried in active RFPs and renewals, and keep the install base on a clear roadmap.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, applied AI, UX, and the Experience, AgentOS and Deep Research product managers, so the data and intelligence layer serves the whole JAI portfolio rather than one surface.
* Market and customer insight: Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings.
* Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery.
* Metrics and performance: Define and report the KPIs for this scope, including adoption of the AI insight surfaces, accuracy against the evaluation set, and delivery against customer commitments.


**Position Requirements**
**What You Will Bring**
* 3\+ years of product management experience in SaaS or enterprise software, including ownership of a product area end to end.
* Hands\-on experience with AI products, including LLM\-powered applications, prompt engineering, retrieval architectures, or applying AI to structured enterprise data.
* Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage.
* A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure.
* Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests.
* Experience with procurement, source\-to\-pay, supply chain or finance data is an advantage.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and working closely with distributed engineering teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.


**Success in This Position**
* An outcome focus, with customer value always in mind.
* Comfortable saying no to a capability that has not met the accuracy bar, and able to explain that decision commercially to sales and to customers.
* Able to hold both a multi\-year product direction and a current\-quarter delivery commitment without losing either.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership.
* Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go\-to\-market teams.
* Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones.

description:
**Description**
 Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network \- figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
   

  

 Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
   

  

 Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network \- from evaluating new lanes to implementing them in production. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. title: VP - Employee Workplace Solutions Management
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

 **Job description**

**In this role, the candidate will manage the following**

* To drive the strategy of IWPB Employee Banking Solutions for the allocated market
* To acquire, maintain relationships and increase product penetration within corporates by engaging with Key Influencers, by leading a team of 14\-15 Relationship Managers to drive EBS, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Any time Credit and Top UP Medical Health Insurance ( BAGIC)
* To ensure that the quality of the corporates acquired are in line with the strategic focus of the Bank
* To ensure the team engages with existing EBS customers to increase penetration across various digital platforms (eg Mobile X \& PIB), IVR Card activations and salary credits.
* Drive open market business (Credit Cards, Personal Loans etc) through activities/deployments, promotions \& lead based calling.
* Develop a robust, diligent and compliant sales channel
* To liaise with product and support teams on a constant basis to enhance customer offerings and service delivery
* To adhere to all regulatory guidelines and handle complaints effectively.
* Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

 **Key activities to be driven**

* Work closely with both the GB/CMB RMs and MSF Business Development Managers (BDM) to engage with key decision makers of target corporates. Actively participate in presenting the HSBC EBS proposition with the objective to empanel them for the salary proposition
* Increase penetration of the corporates employee salary accounts with HSBC in the desired customer segments (Premier, personal Bankers)
* Make corporate work site marketing activities/deployments (WSMs) more interactive and effective
* Drive the overall asset strategy of WPB within the corporate space by identifying under penetrated opportunity segments, showcasing HSBCs offering and driving growth.
* Consistent delivery of the operating plan across all key products like EBS, Personal Banking accounts, PIL Cards, Premier Accounts)
* Controlling/lowering cost of acquisition within mandated cost guidelines
* Optimizing sourcing mix to focus on profitable segments in corporates
* Ensure minimal documentation errors (KYC) by driving the Right First Time behaviour across the team


We are currently seeking a passionate and experienced professional to join our team.

**Requirements**


To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

* University level education, preferably a MBA with 10 \-15 years of experience in banking.
* Front line sales experience is must in onboarding Salary Accounts, Personal Loans, Cards will be preferred.
* Good relationship management skills in order to engage effectively with both corporates and customers.
* Highly self\-motivated and self\-disciplined with the ability to work effectively and independently

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Position Summary**

We bring together product thinking, engineering depth, and cybersecurity domain expertise to design and deploy modern platforms and AI\-enabled solutions for our clients. Join us as we build future\-ready capabilities with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As a
 **Cyber Forward Deployed Engineering Manager** 
 , you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and solution shaping. You will lead cross\-functional teams to design, build, and deploy high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions in client environments. This role requires strong technical depth, delivery ownership, and the ability to translate ambiguous business and cybersecurity needs into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage workstreams end\-to\-end, guide architecture and engineering decisions, mentor engineers, and engage directly with client stakeholders to drive outcomes. You will also play a key role in pursuits, prototypes, and product feedback loops that shape reusable capabilities across Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering offerings.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
**Core Engineering \& Architecture**
* 9–15 years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, including meaningful experience leading full\-stack engineering teams and complex technical deliveries.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Next.js.
* Strong backend development experience in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java (Spring Boot).
* Experience designing and delivering scalable applications using relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
* Deep experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, and serverless architectures.
* Experience architecting and deploying cloud\-native applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, and engineering lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Ability to make sound architecture decisions, evaluate trade\-offs, and enforce engineering quality, security, and maintainability standards.


**AI / GenAI Capabilities**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying GenAI, LLM, or agentic AI solutions in client, enterprise, or production environments.
* Experience with at least one frontier GenAI platform such as Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI, including hands\-on use of products such as Claude API, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, GPT\-4o, Responses API, Assistants API, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong understanding of AI application architectures, including orchestration, grounding, prompt workflows, model integration, evaluation, security, and operationalization.
* Ability to align application design and engineering pipelines to support AI\-enabled use cases in secure, scalable production settings.


**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**
* Proven ability to independently lead defined workstreams or products end\-to\-end with high\-quality, timely delivery.
* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as application security, cloud security, identity, SOC engineering, detection engineering, or cyber analytics.
* Experience in product engineering or platform engineering environments.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.
* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical demos, proofs of concept, or early\-stage solution shaping in consulting or client\-facing environments.


**Work You Will Do**
* Solution Delivery \& Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions aligned to client requirements, enterprise architecture, and security expectations.
* Own technical delivery across one or more workstreams, including planning, architecture, issue resolution, quality management, and execution oversight.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Identify technical risks, delivery dependencies, and design trade\-offs early, and drive mitigation plans to maintain delivery confidence.
* Establish and uphold engineering best practices across code quality, documentation, testing, observability, and security.
* Client Engagement \& Solution Shaping
* Partner with client stakeholders to define technical approaches, clarify requirements, and shape pragmatic, scalable solutions to cybersecurity challenges.
* Support pursuits and pre\-sales efforts through technical storytelling, demos, prototypes, architecture inputs, and feasibility assessments.
* Influence solution direction by balancing client priorities, engineering practicality, cybersecurity requirements, and reusable platform opportunities.
* Act as a trusted technical leader who can bridge business goals and engineering execution.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Mentor and develop engineers through coaching, design reviews, and day\-to\-day delivery leadership.
* Promote a strong team culture centered on accountability, collaboration, learning, and engineering excellence.
* Help teams adopt delivery discipline, reusable patterns, and effective operating rhythms to improve execution quality and speed.
* Product Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
* Capture delivery insights and translate them into reusable product, platform, or engineering improvements.
* Distinguish between client\-specific customization and scalable enhancements that can strengthen Deloitte’s broader Cyber Engineering capabilities.
* Enable client teams and internal teams through structured knowledge transfer, practical documentation, and durable runbooks.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About The Role:** 




 We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Product Manager with strong technical intuition with 5\+ years of experience building cloud\-native, scalable Enterprise SaaS products from the ground up (0 → 1\). You will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from discovery through launch, growth, and maturity for an API\-first platform that helps enterprises solve high\-stakes problems in fraud prevention, identity verification, and customer authentication.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of telecom infrastructure, identity \& security, and enterprise SaaS. You will translate complex operator\-network capabilities into compelling, developer\-friendly API products that help enterprises fight fraud, streamline authentication, and build trust with their customers. You should be someone who has lived through at least one full product lifecycle from MVP to Scale (or Sunset) and thrives in ambiguity, cross\-functional collaboration, and ecosystem\-level strategic thinking.
 



  





**What you’ll be Responsible for:** 



* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap** 
 : Define and drive product strategy, vision, and roadmap for our Enterprise API products. Position our APIs within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack to maximize relevance and stickiness. Define and drive product strategy, vision, and roadmap for Network API products aligned with GSMA Open Gateway and CAMARA API standards.
* **Strategic Discovery \& Ecosystem Thinking** 
 : Conduct deep strategic discovery, customer interviews, competitive intelligence, TAM/SAM analysis, and ecosystem mapping. Think beyond a single API, position the product within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack.
* **Product Metric Ownership** 
 : Own product KPIs end\-to\-end: adoption rates, API call volumes, latency SLAs, conversion funnels, revenue contribution, and customer NPS. Build dashboards using analytics tools, define success metrics, and hold the team accountable to them.
* **Agile Leadership \& Delivery** 
 : Lead agile squads (engineering, design, QA) through sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management. Ensure predictable, high\-quality delivery cadence and clear acceptable criteria.
* **AI\-Enabled Development Lifecycle** 
 : Evaluate and integrate AI/ML\-enabled tools into the development lifecycle from automated testing and code review to intelligent API monitoring and anomaly detection.
* **Go\-to\-Market \& Stakeholder Management** 
 : Partner with Sales, Pre\-Sales, Customer Success, and BD teams to build sales enablement collateral, conduct product demos, and support enterprise deal cycles.
* **Product\-Led Growth (PLG)** 
 : Drive Product\-Led Growth motions: self\-serve onboarding, developer sandbox, usage\-based trials, and in\-product analytics to reduce sales\-cycle friction and accelerate adoption.
* **Developer \& Enterprise UX:** 
 Work closely with UX/Design to deliver intuitive developer portals, API documentation, and integration guides. Ensure the product experience delights both enterprise decision\-makers and integration engineers.
* **Cloud\-Native Fluency:** 
 Collaborate with engineering to ensure cloud\-native architecture best practices, microservices, containerization (Kubernetes), CI/CD, observability, and auto\-scaling are reflected in product decisions.



  





**What should We look in you?** 




  





**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of product management experience building cloud\-native, API\-first, or Enterprise SaaS products.
* Should have BE / B.Tech \& MBA be from Tier 1 institutes
* Demonstrated experience taking a product from 0 → 1 (ideation through launch and scale).
* Lived through at least one complete product lifecycle: MVP → Product\-Market Fit → Scale (or managed a graceful Sunset).
* Hands\-on experience with strategic discovery: customer interviews, TAM/SAM analysis, competitive intelligence, and ecosystem mapping.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: AI and Data-Technical Product Manager-VG-CDAO0266
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Specialist III, Technical Product Manager**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product(s). Products may have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also uses market insights to evaluate product functionality and informs the future product direction based on consumer trends and product performance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Leads technical product management activities for multiple technical products, or one strategic technical product. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches’ technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new technical products. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with business goals and strategy.
* Researches and analyzes market conditions to identify key consumer trends and opportunities for product enhancements or innovation.
* Determines product features and functions by gathering business and customer feedback and translating it into product requirements.
* Prepares product documentation and supports go\-to\-market activities by providing product knowledge to sales and marketing teams.
* Leverages market and performance feedback to evaluate product effectiveness and steer future product direction.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in technical product management, with at least 2 years leading large cross\-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; graduate degree preferred.
* Good to have skills in product lifecycle management, market analysis, product design, user experience evaluation, technical documentation, and cross\-functional stakeholder collaboration. Technical knowledge in software development processes, APIs, cloud platforms, or data\-driven product environments is important.
* Strong communication, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and project execution skills.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute Product Management Certifications, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM). Ability to balance technical feasibility with business viability and user desirability is essential.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

***There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.***
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 As a Staff Product Manager (IC4\) on the IT Service Management (ITSM) product team, you will serve as a principal individual contributor and domain expert driving the next era of enterprise service delivery. This role is designed for a strategic product leader who combines deep technical depth in enterprise IT workflows with the learning agility required to navigate rapidly shifting market dynamics. Sitting at the strategic nexus of Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Customer Success, you will act as a high\-impact cross\-functional leader. You will define and execute an ambitious product vision—continuously refining it based on customer empathy, AI\-driven automation, and real\-time operational feedback. If you possess a relentless drive to master complex domain ecosystems, inspire cross\-functional teams without authority, and transform enterprise IT friction into modern, effortless user experiences, this role offers an expansive platform for your craft.
   

  





**The Impact You Can Create**



* **Pioneer Bold Innovation:** 
 Drive market\-defining ITSM features from concept to production, leveraging thought leadership to keep our enterprise platform at the bleeding edge of intelligent service management.
* **Orchestrate Cross\-Functional Success:** 
 Build aligned, high\-velocity team ecosystems where Engineering, UX, Sales, and GTM teams execute in lockstep to achieve aggressive revenue, adoption, and customer retention targets.
* **Deliver Global Scale \& Value:** 
 Continuously analyze user telemetry and enterprise landscapes to deploy intuitive, low\-friction capabilities that eliminate critical operational bottlenecks for global IT teams.
* **Demystify Complex Architectures:** 
 Deconstruct intricate ITSM backend workflows, ITIL frameworks, and integration layers into clean, scalable technical requirements—accelerating developer velocity and minimizing execution risk.



**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**




**1\. Vision, Strategy \& Strategy Adaptation**



* Own the long\-term product vision and multi\-year strategy for our ITSM capabilities, seamlessly integrating market research, user behavioral data, and emerging technology trends into an actionable roadmap.
* Maintain an agile, high\-conviction roadmap capable of fluidly adapting to shifting enterprise priorities, competitive shifts, and technical discoveries without losing strategic momentum.
* Demonstrate bold thought leadership by challenging legacy ITSM paradigms and introducing modern, self\-service, and AI\-first product paradigms.



**2\. Requirements Definition \& Lifecycle Management**



* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle—from initial problem discovery and UX journey mapping to detailed PRDs, roadmap prioritization, and feature rollout.
* Translate complex IT operational workflows, service desk mechanics, and routing logic into exceptionally clear, developer\-ready technical requirements.
* Maintain daily operational execution standards across engineering squads, driving high velocity in a fast\-paced release environment.



**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Alignment**



* Partner intimately with UX Design and Engineering to co\-author elegant, accessible solutions tailored for both IT administrators and end\-users.
* Serve as the primary communications bridge across the business, keeping internal partners (Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Leadership) and external stakeholders aligned on delivery timelines and strategic value.
* Drive alignment across executive and cross\-functional leadership through transparent, data\-backed product narratives and clear ROI justification.



**4\. Customer Advocacy \& Co\-Creation**



* Partner directly with enterprise IT leaders, sysadmins, and end\-users to prioritize critical pain points, map high\-impact themes, and co\-design solution workflows.
* Cultivate deep user empathy to convert complex service desk friction into intuitive, consumer\-grade product experiences.



**Skills \& Core Competencies**




**Adaptability \& Learning Agility**



* **Ecosystem Fluidity:** 
 A proven ability to rapidly deconstruct, master, and stay ahead of evolving ITSM frameworks, API ecosystems, and modern enterprise IT infrastructure.
* **Resilience in Motion:** 
 High comfort reprioritizing strategies and roadmaps mid\-cycle in response to new data, technical constraints, or shifting market demands.
* **Problem\-Solving Rigor:** 
 Exceptional analytical capabilities to break down ambiguous, multi\-layered enterprise problems into structured, iterative release phases.



**Cross\-Functional \& Human Capabilities**



* **Inclusive Communication:** 
 Superior written and verbal communication skills, with a natural ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear executive business value, and vice versa.
* **Matrix Influence:** 
 Demonstrated capability to guide, align, and inspire distributed, cross\-functional software teams without direct organizational authority.
* **Active Listening:** 
 High empathy and active listening skills to accurately surface the underlying operational needs of enterprise customers and internal stakeholders.



**Technical \& Domain Expertise**



* **Product Development Mastery:** 
 End\-to\-end fluency across both technical and business layers of SaaS product delivery—from telemetry\-driven prioritization to go\-to\-market positioning.
* **ITSM Specialization:** 
 Comprehensive understanding of modern IT Service Management workflows—including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management, Service Catalog, and AI\-assisted Service Desk automation.


**Qualifications**

**Qualifications \& Experience**



* **Educational Foundation:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience coupled with a track record of continuous technical growth).
* **Product Leadership:** 
 9\+ years of dedicated SaaS product management experience, demonstrating progressive ownership of complex enterprise software products.
* **SaaS Industry Native:** 
 5\+ years of experience operating within the fast\-scaling, iterative execution cycles of the B2B SaaS industry.
* **Domain Depth:** 
 3\+ years specifically managing products explicitly built for IT or developer teams, with deep exposure to ITSM, ITOM, Service Desk, or workflow automation platforms.
* **Fast\-Paced Delivery:** 
 Documented track record of repeatedly shipping high\-impact software capabilities within rapid release environments while making rigorous data\-driven decisions that balance near\-term execution with long\-term platform health.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.

* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.

* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.

* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.

* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills

This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**

description:
**Job title** 
 :
 **Atlassian Platform Owner**
* Location: Hyderabad


**About Opella**
 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people' s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world' s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As an Atlassian Platform Owner at Opella, you'll lead platform strategy, governance, reliability and adoption across Jira, Confluence and related apps. You will blend platform product management, agile enablement and vendor/financial stewardship while partnering with Admins, Coaches, Security and Business stakeholders.
   

  

 The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.
   

  

**Our Team**
 As an Atlassian Administrator at Opella, you'll play a crucial role in our Enabling Platforms \& DevOps team, delivering solutions that support our global operations. You'll be at the forefront of implementing and optimizing our Atlassian Cloud portfolio products and integration with marketplace apps and custom solutions, while also bridging the gap between development and project management.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 As an Atlassian Platform Owner at Opella, you'll lead platform strategy, governance, reliability and adoption across Jira, Confluence and related apps. You will blend platform product management, agile enablement and vendor/financial stewardship while partnering with Admins, Coaches, Security and Business stakeholders.
   

  

 The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.
   

  

**Platform Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and maintain the Atlassian platform vision, strategy, and multi\-quarter roadmap, aligning to organizational priorities and agile practices.
* Ensure alignment of the platform with agile best practices and team workflows to optimize productivity, transparency, and collaboration.
* Track and analyze platform performance, adoption, and value metrics; identify improvement areas and drive strategic enhancements.


**Operations, Reliability \& Upgrades**
* Oversee and manage the Atlassian platform (Jira, Confluence, and related services) as a product, ensuring availability, scalability, and strong user experience.
* Manage platform upgrades, configuration baselines, maintenance windows, and release/change calendars; communicate change impacts effectively.
* Coordinate incident response, problem management, and root cause analysis with support teams; maintain runbooks and SLAs.


**Governance, Compliance \& Security**
* Establish and maintain governance for usage, project/site standards, naming conventions, workflows, fields, and permission models.
* Implement data lifecycle policies, backup/restore patterns, content retention, and access controls in partnership with Security and Compliance.
* Ensure compliance requirements (e.g., GxP in Consumer Healthcare contexts) are enforced through process, validation, documentation, and controls.


**Vendor, Licensing \& Budget Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for Atlassian vendor management: contracts, renewals, usage reviews, performance monitoring, and escalations.
* Manage marketplace apps portfolio (e.g., ScriptRunner, Xray, Comala, draw.io, Snapshots, Guard, Compass, Loom) including value assessments and lifecycle decisions.
* Monitor budget and expenditures for licenses, apps, and operations; forecast demand, right\-size plans, and optimize costs.


**Partnerships \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for Sanofi counterparts, ensuring bidirectional alignment on policies, integrations, and governance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and continuously improve the platform to meet evolving business needs.
* Partner closely with Agile Coaches and the Atlassian Administrator(s) to balance configuration agility with platform stability and standards.


**Integrations, Automation \& Extensibility**
* Oversee design and quality of integrations (Forge apps, REST APIs, enterprise systems) ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Guide adoption of automation to eliminate manual tasks, standardize workflows, and improve data quality and reporting.
* Evaluate and govern custom solutions for sustainability, documentation, and support readiness.


**Enablement, Training \& Adoption**
* Lead training and onboarding programs to ensure teams leverage Jira/Confluence effectively for Scrum, Kanban, and scaled practices.
* Curate templates, playbooks, dashboards, and guidance that support consistent, simple, and value\-focused usage.
* Promote the platform as the system of record for delivery, replacing manual reporting with automated, real\-time insights.


**About You**
**Technical Background**
* 5\+ years owning or administering Atlassian Cloud platforms at scale, including Jira Software and Confluence.
* Deep knowledge of workflows, issue types, fields, schemes, permission models, boards, dashboards, Advanced Roadmaps (Plans), and release management.
* Hands\-on experience with automation (native Automation, ScriptRunner), JQL, and reporting; comfortable guiding admins on best\-practice configurations.
* Experience integrating Atlassian with enterprise systems (via Forge, REST APIs, and standardized integration patterns).
* Familiarity with marketplace apps such as Xray, Comala Document Management, diagrams.net, Guard, Compass, and Snapshots.
* Understanding of agile practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and how to operationalize them within Jira/Confluence.
* Awareness of compliance frameworks (e.g., GxP in Consumer Healthcare), data protection, and audit requirements as applied to Atlassian Cloud.
* Atlassian certifications (ACP) and/or Scrum/Agile certifications.


**Soft Skills**
* Strategic product mindset: able to define vision, prioritize roadmaps, and measure value realization.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management; influences from teams to executives.
* Change leadership: drives adoption, simplifies complexity, and replaces manual reporting with data\-driven practices.
* Structured, pragmatic problem\-solver; balances standardization with team autonomy.
* Customer\-centric, hands\-on when needed, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

* All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
* Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
* Outcome\-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
* Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.


 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: Manager, IT Delivery
description:
**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high\-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
   

  

 The manager will have end\-to\-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product\-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop high\-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product\-oriented teams with end\-to\-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross\-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business\-outcome ownership.
* Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product\-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data\-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud\-based data platforms and AI\-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.


**Key Success Factors**
* Experience in data\-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high\-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross\-functional environment.
* Commitment to engineering quality, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

**Financial wellness**
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

**Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
